jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.

This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.

IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.

Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.

IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
• Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

Our client is a global provider of biological products serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CRO partners. It supplies high-quality biospecimens and cell-based solutions that accelerate drug discovery, preclinical development, and disease research.

Jobomschrijving

• Customer & Account Management: Act as the main point of contact for key accounts, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality communication with customers and suppliers while handling orders, inquiries, and after-sales support.
• Cross-Departmental Support & Business Development: Plan, organise, and manage workload to support business development and assist all departments with reports, data, and resources to ensure smooth operations.
• Compliance, Quality & Safety: Maintain adherence to company policies, SOPs, ISO standards, and health & safety regulations while protecting confidential information and promoting company standards.

• Ability to express fluently in English and mandarin/chinese
• Attention to detail,
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills,
• Enthusiasm, energy and determination,
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
• Customer oriented mindset

Our client is an international company, leader in its field and present in your daily life.

Jobomschrijving

• Daily contact with customers via e-mail
• Monitor delivery times and prices, take action where necessary
• Providing correct advice to customers
• Ensuring the correct entry of orders into the inventory system on a daily basis
• Order follow-up (RMA, complaints, pricing, back orders,...)
• Preparation of proforma invoices based on Excel data

• You are a customer-oriented, problem-solving team player.
• You have worked in expedition previously and have knowledge of customs regulations
• In addition, you are fluent in French and English
• A good knowledge of MS Office
• A knowledge of incoterms is a big plus!

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:

• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:

• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
• Good physical fitness.
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

jobs.occupation: Junior IT Support -  Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager Top 3 - Retail Sector

• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: AML & Financial Crime - International Bank - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international corporate and investment bank with a strong presence across EMEA. The organisation supports multinational clients through a broad range of banking, capital markets, and advisory services while maintaining a strong commitment to compliance, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

As an AML & Compliance professional your responsibilities are:

• Provide AML, sanctions, and financial crime guidance to business and support teams.
• Act as a key point of contact for financial crime compliance matters.
• Assess the impact of new regulations and support implementation projects.
• Investigate potential regulatory breaches and support remediation actions.
• Manage financial crime-related projects and report progress to senior management.

• Support regulatory, audit, and compliance recommendations implementation.

• Assist in drafting and updating compliance policies and procedures.
• Participate in Financial Crime Risk Assessments and mitigation initiatives.
• Contribute to compliance action plans and governance reporting.

A successful AML & Compliance professional should have:

• Experience within AML, Compliance, Financial Crime or KYC.

• Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Medical Devices - EN
jobs.description:
International healthcare organization active in the medical device sector, supporting patient care through innovative products distributed across multiple global markets.

As a successful Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Medical Devices - EN, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Coordinate product registrations across assigned international markets
• Prepare and submit regulatory documentation with internal and external stakeholders
• Support ongoing compliance activities for medical device portfolios
• Manage regulatory aspects of product changes throughout the lifecycle
• Review and assess regulatory implications of marketing materials
• Monitor regulatory developments and communicate relevant updates

As a successful Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Medical Devices - EN, you will have the following profile:

Interested in building your accounting career in an international environment? Apply asap

Our client is a leading international trading and business services organization with its European headquarters in Zaventem. They are urge,tly looking for a (junior) Accountant. 

This position offers an excellent opportunity for both junior accounting professionals and ambitious graduates looking to build a career in finance.

• Support colleagues with accounting and invoice-related questions.
• Follow up on outstanding items and ensure accurate financial administration.
• Assist with monthly closings, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
• Prepare documentation for audits and support compliance activities.
• Contribute to process improvements and maintain accounting procedures.

• Ideally 2 to 3 years of experience in an accounting role.
• Motivated graduates with a strong interest in accounting are encouraged to apply.

Your Skills

• Strong analytical and numerical skills.
• Well-organized and able to manage multiple priorities.
• Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement mentality.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work with various stakeholders.
• Team player with a professional attitude.
• Fluent in English, with a good knowledge of Dutch and French.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm

Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?

• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.
• Forklift certification required.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:

• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner
• Checking products for quality and quantity
• Preparing orders for shipment
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:

• Have experience as an Order Picker 
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully
• Speak English or Dutch
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.
• Using measuring tools during the production process.
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Our client is an FMCG player active in household products and based in Walloon Brabant.

As a Sales Support German/English your responsibilities are:

• Proficiency with standard office software and CRM tools
• Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving

Our client is a large organisation operating in a technical and project-driven environment. Known for its collaborative and people-oriented culture, the company offers a stable environment where initiative, professionalism, and continuous development are encouraged.

As a Management Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and coordinate a Director's agenda
• Organise meetings, appointments, and business-related activities
• Handle incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
• Act as a liaison between senior management and internal/external stakeholders

• Prepare documents in French, Dutch, and English
• Process purchase orders, expense reports, and reimbursements

• Knowledge of financial terminology or reporting is an asset

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.

Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.

Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.

To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

Basic Requirements:

• Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.
• A solid understanding of electricity is a must.
• Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.
• Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.
• Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).
• No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).
• Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.
• Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.
Additional Information:

• You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).
• You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).
• You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.
• A driver’s license is not required.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.Concretely you will:

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills
